presentation: Each image is a calm3:2 landscape two-view design board. Left about30percent: expressive head-and-shoulders portrait. Right about70percent: complete same adult, head and both feet fully framed, combat-ready pose, exactly one signature weapon. Quiet pale background, contact shadow only. No location, monster, secondary inventory, second costume, upgrade diagram or baked-in lettering. Portrait and body share exact face, hair, age and outfit. Power progression is external concept text; at most one restrained current-power cue may be depicted.
intent: Eighteen new desirable progression-fantasy leads or rivals, two per original starred rendering style. Broad range of sleek, imposing, regal, feral, enigmatic and unconventional appeal. None is approved canon or a required pair. Fourteen fair/light complexions and four light-olive/light-tan complexions, nine women and nine men, ages22–37. Original anchors supply rendering and appeal, not character, costume, weapon or scenery designs.

entries.costume: Orange high-neck short balloon-sleeve battle jacket over a fitted green torso, turquoise slim combat trousers and cream high boots. Big sleeves contrast the narrow waist and legs, no cropped singlet.
entries.pose: Offset balanced stance, single flail held by its turquoise handle with the short chain hanging in one clear arc and the ball resting on the ground outside her foot; free hand on hip.
entries.portrait_expression: A delighted open-mouthed cackle with one eye slightly narrowed.

weapon.name: Afterbell
weapon.description: A single armored flail ball joined to its handle by three heavy links.

power.name: Thunder Echo
power.description: The flail seals thunder inside its ball and releases a second shock after impact. She must keep the chain controlled or take the returning shock herself.

progression: Add a delayed thunderclap to one strike.
Guide one sonic ricochet around a guard.
Build a three-impact thunder rhythm that shatters a boss’s defensive stance.
entries.current_power_cue: One orange panel seam on the ball lights with a tiny electric glint; no duplicate ball.
entries.weapon_visual: Single-ball flail. One cream spherical head with three broad orange armor panels, a short chain of exactly three large closed links and one turquoise handle. One ball only; no spikes, extra chain tails or orbiting copies. Grip/contact: One hand wraps the handle, chain visibly attaches to handle and ball at opposite ends.

entries.title: Silas
entries.caption: Enigmatic beautiful predator; controlled grace with an unsettlingly direct gaze.
entries.combat_role: Enigmatic beautiful predator; controlled grace with an unsettlingly direct gaze.
entries.silhouette: Very tall slender build, long shoulders and narrow hips, elegant strong hands.
entries.face: Hollow oval cheeks, a long fine nose, drooping dark brows, pale gray eyes and soft full lips; no half-black half-white hair.
entries.hair: Short coal-black hair in a sleek deep waved side part with a close undercut, both ears visible.
entries.costume: Ivory sleeveless robe with a high curved collar and one long asymmetric crimson-lined panel over fitted black trousers, silver low boots; exposed upper arms, no cropped black jacket or white geometric shirt.
entries.pose: Long quiet side stance, single scythe held upright outside the body, blade curves away above shoulder level and does not cross the portrait or face; free hand at his sternum.
entries.portrait_expression: Gentle almost-sympathetic smile that does not reach the eyes.

weapon.name: Morrow Hook
weapon.description: A long black scythe with an ivory blade and crimson seam.

power.name: Last Requiem
power.description: The scythe catches the last combat instinct of a defeated spirit and lends it to its wielder. Each borrowed instinct pushes against his own judgment.

progression: Borrow one spectral enemy’s final evasive step.
Call one bound spirit to repeat a single protective strike.
Forge a pact with a great spectral beast whose power changes the scythe and his fighting form.
entries.current_power_cue: One faint crimson light inside the ivory blade root; no summoned figure, monster or second shadow-person.
entries.weapon_visual: Scythe. One matte black long shaft with a single broad ivory inward-curving blade and one thin crimson seam at the blade root; no flowers, branching thorns, floating petals or second blade. Grip/contact: One hand clearly around the shaft below the head; full continuous shaft and complete blade framed.

entries.title: Vire
entries.caption: Regal and exacting foil rival; mature fashion beauty with unmistakable dueling intent.
entries.combat_role: Regal and exacting foil rival; mature fashion beauty with unmistakable dueling intent.
entries.silhouette: Sleek athletic torso, strong hips, long legs and broad controlled shoulders.
entries.face: Broad high cheekbones, heart-shaped face, strong slightly upturned nose, narrow dark eyes and a finely shaped firm mouth.
entries.hair: Muted strawberry-blond hair sculpted into a smooth shoulder-length side wave, forehead open; no shaved head or divided hair color.
entries.costume: Black fitted high-neck combat jumpsuit with one solid silver crescent-shaped breastplate and a single crisp bone waist panel, long black gloves and flat silver shoes. No black long coat, flaring petal collar or decorative chains.
entries.pose: Precise forward fencing stance, foil in one hand extended low enough to leave face clear, free arm curved behind, both feet fully visible.
entries.portrait_expression: Cool displeasure with a slight raised chin, lips pressed together.

weapon.name: Mercy Seam
weapon.description: A slender silver dueling blade with a black teardrop guard.

power.name: Bound Trajectory
power.description: Pins one attack's trajectory to the line her foil has just traced. Limit: Requires real contact anchors; breaking or moving an anchor unravels its line.

progression: Keep one intercepted thrust on a predictable line.
Bind the path between two contacted points for a heartbeat.
Weave three fixed trajectories into a temporary dueling boundary.
entries.current_power_cue: Only the crimson centerline inside the foil; no web across the board.
entries.weapon_visual: Long dueling foil. One very thin straight silver blade with a single crimson line along its center, a solid black teardrop guard and one plain white grip. No thread coils, multiple blades or floating needle swarm. Grip/contact: One closed hand behind the guard, wrist aligned to the single continuous blade.
